objective: Deterministically plan how one already-resolved operator or lead Telnyx voice event changes a durable TelnyxCallBridge snapshot without performing persistence, provider commands, webhook work, or contact-attempt mutation.
rules: call.initiated is observational and does not advance bridge state.
operator call.answered advances operator-dial-requested to operator-answered and records the operator call_control_id.
lead call.answered may catch up operator-answered through lead-dial-requested to lead-answered because answered evidence proves the lead dial occurred.
lead call.answered before operator answer is deferred rather than violating operator-first ordering.
call.bridged advances only after the durable bridge has reached lead-answered or bridge-requested.
call.bridged arriving before lead-answered is deferred instead of inventing missing leg evidence.
call.hangup after bridged completes the bridge.
call.hangup before bridged fails the bridge with a deterministic role-specific bridge failure code.
hangup cause text does not become the canonical bridge failure code.
duplicate or late evidence against an already-advanced or terminal bridge is an idempotent no-op.
The planner does not mutate InsuranceContactAttempt state.
next: INS-002E2C3C can execute these plans against durable bridge persistence with optimistic stale-bridge recovery.
